verdict.rationale: Intuit officially publishes and maintains SDKs/clients (Node.js OAuth client, PHP SDK for the QBO V3 REST API) with documented OAuth flows, CRUD examples, and error handling, giving AI-native developers concrete official building blocks. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond Intuit's own repos, and a fully working openapi.json/llms.txt discovery endpoint (probes show 404s).
